'''Roxanne Beck''' is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was credited under the name of '''Annie Pondel''' for the first two seasons. In subsequent seasons, she was credited under her real name.

==Pokémon roles==
Beck started voicing characters in {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[S01|season one]]. She worked on the series up until she was removed from the credits towards the end of [[S05|season five]]. She has played the voices of some of the most well-known [[Character of the day|characters of the day]].
